title: Reference approach: Profiling Investigation
answer: Implement profiling investigation in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: torch.profiler.profile, record_function. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 125. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU]) as prof:
    x=torch.randn(128,128); y=x @ x
print(len(prof.key_averages())>0)
reference_code:
import torch
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU]) as prof:
    x=torch.randn(128,128); y=x @ x
print(len(prof.key_averages())>0)
